item.title: No. 19 Women’s Tennis upsets No. 2 Texas A&M in Home Opener
item.description: Down goes the Aggies. In their first match of the season in Malibu, Pepperdine defeats Texas A&M 4-1. The post No. 19 Women’s Tennis upsets No. 2 Texas A&M in Home Opener appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Law School Hosts Supreme Court Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson for Dual Events
item.description: Pepperdine Caruso School of Law hosted Supreme Court Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson for the final round of an annual Moot Court competition and a speaker event. At the speaker event, Jackson discussed her memoir with Dean Paul Caron. The post Law School Hosts Supreme Court Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson for Dual Events appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Women’s Basketball Pulls Off 74-72 Upset Win at Santa Clara
item.description: Pepperdine Women's Basketball pulled off a 74-72 upset win at Santa Clara on Saturday Jan. 31 at the Leavey Center in Santa Clara, Calif. Four Waves finished in double figures with Lina Falk and Shorna Preston leading the way for Pepperdine. The post Women’s Basketball Pulls Off 74-72 Upset Win at Santa Clara appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: ‘Rich in Giving’: International Studies Student Leads with Compassion
item.description: From a small town in Ethiopia to Pepperdine, senior Tsion Gerbaba’s journey has shaped her vision of leadership. Now an International Studies student, she approaches the world with creativity and faith — with the goal of serving others. The post ‘Rich in Giving’: International Studies Student Leads with Compassion appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Men’s Basketball Falls 83-81 In Close Battle at Seattle
item.description: Pepperdine Men's Basketball fell 83-81 in a close battle with Seattle University on Wednesday Feb. 4 at the Redhawk Center in Seattle, Wash. Aaron Clark and Styles Phipps finished as the Waves top two scores, putting up 22 and 18 points respectively. The post Men’s Basketball Falls 83-81 In Close Battle at Seattle appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Global Learning Week Shifts Students’ Lens
item.description: Pepperdine’s 12th annual Global Learning Week took place from Jan. 26-30. Hosted by International Programs, Global Learning Week celebrates global citizenship by deepening Pepperdine students' cross-cultural understanding with diverse events and hands-on activities. item.title: Women’s Basketball Find Success in Historic Start
item.description: The Pepperdine Women's Basketball team got off to their best start in 45 years with a 9-3 record. As they look toward March, the Waves are carrying their wins and losses with them through the rest of season. item.title: Campus Recreation Keeps Community Active
item.description: Students, faculty and staff are finding new ways to stay active on campus. Between fitness classes and club sports, Campus Recreation has helped the community balance wellness and fitness. The post Campus Recreation Keeps Community Active appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Women’s Basketball Gets Revenge Against the Cougars
item.description: Pepperdine Women's Basketball beat the Washington State University Cougars 78-62 in a revenge game Feb. 7 at Firestone Fieldhouse. The Waves now extend the win streak to four games, their largest streak of the season. The post Women’s Basketball Gets Revenge Against the Cougars appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.
